operators.name: custom_mean_reduce
semantics: Computes mean over dimensions (1,2,3) with keepdim=True, exactly matching torch.mean(x, dim=(1,2,3), keepdim=True).
Input is contiguous float32 CUDA tensor with shape [128, 3, 2048, 2048].
Output is float32 CUDA tensor with shape [128, 1, 1, 1] and stride [1,1,1,1].
Reduction is performed with float accumulation; scaling divides by total elements per batch (3*2048*2048 = 12582912).
No bias, no broadcasting; each batch element independently reduced.

operators.name: custom_tan
semantics: Input is contiguous float32 CUDA tensor shape [128,1,1,1].
Output is float32 CUDA tensor with same shape.
Input shape [128,3,2048,2048] float32 CUDA, output shape [128,1,1,1].
Mean computed as sum over all values per batch divided by 12582912, using float32 accumulation.
Elementwise tan on shape [128,1,1,1] float32 CUDA, output same shape.
